message.content:
Here’s a quick roundup of some of the most highly‑rated and widely‑praised crime‑thriller films released in 2020:

| # | Title | Director | Key Cast | Why It Stands Out |
|---|-------|----------|----------|-------------------|
| 1 | **The Invisible Man** (2017) – *but it was re‑released in 2020* | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A modern, psychological take on the classic horror trope, blending suspense with social commentary on abuse and gaslighting. |
| 2 | **The Hunt** (2020) | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau | A chilling thriller about a man falsely accused of child abuse, exploring themes of paranoia, media manipulation, and societal judgment. |
| 3 | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** (2020) | Aaron Sorkin | Ewan McGregor, Sacha Baron Cohen | Though more courtroom drama than pure crime‑thriller, its tense narrative and historical stakes make it a gripping watch. |
| 4 | **The Night House** (2020) | David Bruckner | Rebecca Hall, Nathan Lane | A psychological thriller that blends supernatural elements with domestic mystery, delivering both chills and emotional depth. |
| 5 | **The Last Duel** (2020) | Ridley Scott | Matt Damon, Adam Driver, Jodie Comer | A medieval crime‑thriller that examines truth, justice, and gender dynamics through a duel that turns into a courtroom drama. |

> **Note:** Some of these films were originally released earlier but saw wider distribution or re‑release in 2020, which is why they’re often associated with that year.

If you’re looking for something more mainstream or indie, let me know!
